verdict.rationale: docs.gusto.com serves a plain-text llms.txt index (HTTP 200) that lists every guide and API reference page as markdown (.md) links, which is exactly an agent-pointable docs surface. The docs also describe a Dev Assistant MCP server that lets AI tools read the documentation directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt, and evidence that agent-oriented docs extend beyond the Embedded Payroll developer docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
